description: Checks a public website from the outside, like a visitor: speed on a phone, search (SEO), security, accessibility and content. Returns a score from 0 to 100 for each and the findings, most serious first. Takes up to a minute; if it is not finished, call get_check_results with the check_id. A check of the same website is reused for 24 hours. Free.

business_name.description: The business's name, if you know it.

country.description: Two-letter code of the main country the business serves, for example AE, AU, GB or US. Used for search rankings and ChatGPT's answers.

website.description: The website address, for example yourcompany.com.

name: check_website
title: Check a website
